title: You may not believe in luck or Divine, but every page The Sage opens up has nutrients to fill our cup Sounds in time and thoughts in cadence reflectiv
summary: You may not believe in luck or Divine, but every page The Sage opens up has nutrients to fill our cup Sounds in time and thoughts in cadence reflective rhymes wafting in a fragrance of effectiveness #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
You may not believe
in luck or Divine,
but every page
The Sage opens up
has nutrients
to fill our cup
Sounds in time
and
thoughts in cadence
reflective rhymes
wafting in a
fragrance of
effectiveness
#smallpoems
